meta.description: Appendix B.5 of the AI GTM bootcamp, built as a real importable workflow. Five nodes: webhook trigger, HTTP Request enrichment, IF branch on whether enrichment resolved, Code node running the rubric, and an error branch that routes to a human instead of guessing. Import via n8n > Workflows > Import from File. The Week 1 'done when' is rebuilding this from a blank canvas with no tutorial open, so read it, then close it and rebuild it badly from memory. Badly is the point.

nodes.name: Webhook: Form Submission
nodes.notes: NODE 1, the trigger. Expects JSON: contact_name, email, message, requested_demo, pricing_page_visits, emails_opened. Test with: curl -X POST <webhook-url> -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"contact_name":"Jane Doe","email":"ops@northwind-health.com","requested_demo":true,"pricing_page_visits":3,"emails_opened":5}'

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Enrich Company
nodes.notes: NODE 2, and the one to spend disproportionate time on. This single node calls any API from inside a workflow, which is exactly where your existing API skill transfers and where most no-code users are weakest. Two settings matter: timeout, and neverError so a provider 4xx flows to the IF branch instead of killing the run. Swap the URL for Clay or Cognism without touching anything downstream.

nodes.name: IF: Enrichment Resolved?
nodes.notes: NODE 3. The fork. true goes to scoring, false goes to a human. This node is the reason the system has an abstain path at all: an unresolved company is not a bad company, and treating a miss as a zero silently disqualifies good leads.

nodes.name: Code: Score & Route
nodes.notes: NODE 4. Deliberately mirrors rubric.json in src/. Keeping them in sync by hand is a real cost; the reason to accept it is that the Python version is what the golden set is evaluated against, and the n8n version is what a GTM team would actually run.

nodes.name: Code: Needs Human
nodes.notes: NODE 5. The interview point: this is not an error handler bolted on, it is a routing destination with equal standing to the other three.
